verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Projects offering a natural-language command interface for operating projects, such as creating items, changing fields or building views by typed instruction. Assigning an issue to Copilot delegates coding work rather than letting you operate Projects in natural language. The GraphQL API, CLI and official MCP server are developer building blocks or belong to other stories, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
